newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares dip as nervous investors tested.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares dip as nervous investors tested.

text.p: Prices on the Estonian stock exchange on Friday dipped as investors became nervous of recent big gains made in banking stocks, dealers said.
Total volume on the official list reached 70 million kroons of shares and the Tallinn stock exchange index eased slightly with a 1.38 percent decrease to 232.85.
"The market was very nervous in the morning when the market opened," one dealer said.
"As soon as trading started the bid side dominated and most stocks fell quickly, but activity settled down after midday," he added.
Hansapank was the most traded stock with over 18.4 million kroons of shares changing hands to finish 1.95 kroons weaker on 236.50 kroons.
Forekspank trade was high with 17.4 million kroons of shares turned over to slump 5.25 kroons to end on 163.50.
Hoiupank lost ground to end trade on 117.25 kroons, four kroons less after a trade of 17.3 million kroons of shares.
Uhispank saw trade of 9.9 million kroons of shares to firm by 0.25 kroons to 46.75 kroons.
"Uhispank tried to move higher on the news that they will hold Tallinn city's budget but selling pressure kept the price from rising," another dealer said.
Tallinna Pank dipped by 1.20 to 68.50 kroons, after a trade of four million kroons of shares.
Tallinna Farma slipped one kroon to close on 118.00 after turning over 2.4 million kroon of shares.
On the free market, trade was slow with only 4.6 million kroons of shares.
Rakvere meat plant was the most active with 1.9 million kroons of shares traded to close 0.25 kroons lower on 14.30 kroons.
